annotations.title: Does CBAM or the EU Deforestation Regulation apply to a product? (paid)

description: Use before importing a product into the EU: checks the HS/CN code against CBAM Annex I and EUDR Annex I and says which applies, from when, and what the importer must do (CBAM declarant status and emissions data; EUDR due diligence statement with plot geolocation). No code? Send product and the likely 6-digit HS code is suggested (and marked as a suggestion). Input: hs or product, optional origin (ISO country) and tonnes_per_year. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

origin.description: ISO country of origin, e.g. CN

tonnes_per_year.description: Yearly tonnes of CBAM goods you import
